title: ChatGPT did my entire yard sale in minutes
description:
I asked ChatGPT to sell the clutter in my house and it did almost all of it. Using ChatGPT agent mode, it identified each item from a photo, looked up the real market price, wrote the perfect listing, and posted it to Facebook Marketplace for me. This is one of the easiest ways to make money with ChatGPT and finally declutter. If you want to learn how to use ChatGPT to sell your old stuff, this shows the exact flow. Comment SELL and grab the prompts.

#Shorts #ChatGPT #AI

Get every prompt I used to sell my stuff with ChatGPT here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QvBcSgMpLq9gBlY8bfaoRsXR_1PeLD7evL-2IgkVdYg/edit?usp=sharing
